SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) Diary No(s). 1989/2023  (Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 27-02-2018  in WPC No. 1755/2016 passed by the High Court Of Delhi At New  Delhi)
 GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI & ANR. Petitioner(s)
 VERSUS  JAI PRAKASH GUPTA & ORS. Respondent(s)
 (FOR ADMISSION and I.R. and IA No.18756/2023-CONDONATION OF DELAY  IN FILING )
 Date : 09-02-2023 This petition was called on for hearing today.

entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New  Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.R. SHAH  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.T. RAVIKUMAR  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KAROL  For Petitioner(s) Ms. Astha Tyagi, AOR  Mr. Dinesh Chander Trehan, Adv.
 Ms. Diksha Narula, Adv.
 For Respondent(s)

UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has pointed out that in paragraph 10 of the impugned order, the Honble High Court has observed that the possession of subject land has been taken on 09.09.2009 and even as per the revenue records, the compensation has been deposited in the Court of ADJ.

It is submitted that, therefore, in view of the decision of the Constitution Bench of this Court Indore Development Authority vs. Manoharlal and Others, (2020) 8 SCC 129, the Honble High Court has erred in declaring that the acquisition with respect to the land in question is deemed to have lapsed under Section 24 (2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
